purpose: Bundle-first wanted list for papers that are high-value review targets but do not currently have an obvious matching local PDF in the private library. This file intentionally tracks wanted assets before they become formal paper records in data/papers.json.

bundles.title: STDP, hidden spike patterns, and constructive synapse initialization
bundles.thesis_anchor: Chapters 3, 6, and 7 of /workspace/thesis-constructive-spiking; especially hidden spike-pattern detection and competitive STDP pattern learning.
bundles.rationale: The thesis cites Masquelier2008a and Masquelier2008b heavily, but no obvious Masquelier PDFs were found by filename in /workspace/growing-neural-networks-library. These are anchor sources for turning the thesis-derived STDP construction material into grounded public reviews.

bundles.title: STDP background mechanisms for constructive spiking reviews
bundles.thesis_anchor: Chapter 2 literature review and the STDP-dependent experimental chapters of /workspace/thesis-constructive-spiking.
bundles.rationale: These papers are not necessarily constructive algorithms themselves, but they provide the STDP mechanism background needed to keep spiking construction reviews accurate and well-grounded.

notes: This file is deliberately narrower than data/paper-assets.json: it tracks prominent wanted assets for bundle planning, including papers not yet added to data/papers.json.

When a wanted PDF is collected, keep the PDF outside Git, update this file or remove the wanted entry, and only then decide whether to promote the paper into data/papers.json plus data/paper-assets.json.
